text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the whirlwind summer training camp 
came to an end. A summer spent recklessly 
chasing after good fortune...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you so much! Thanks to you, 
I had a truly miraculous, blessed time!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
By the way, there's one last thing I 
wanted to ask. Earlier, I was doing petal 
divination.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"She can run well in the Kikuka Sho, she 
can't, she can, she can't..." that's how 
it went.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: And then, the result said "You can do it"!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes... But after the fortune-telling, when 
I looked at my hand, the chrysanthemum 
petals had fallen tragically...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Which one is this supposed to be? Good 
luck or bad luck? *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The answer remains unknown. Carrying both 
hope and anxiety, the road continues on to 
the Autumn Classic Road.
